title: Trigger Happy
desc: (Formerly Gun Game 3D.) A browser-based 3D multiplayer shooter (Three.js + WebRTC) to play with friends, with bots.

title: Hollow Badge
desc: A dark first-person detective game in your browser. Four cases, one collector. Free, no download. Contains disturbing themes.

title: Mimic
desc: A free first-person horror game in your browser. It records your voice and uses it to lure you, and your friends, into the dark.

title: Neon Void Runner
desc: A first-person neon space platformer for Chrome, built with Three.js. You play an astronaut on glowing floating platforms: run, double jump, shoot alien drones, collect stars and reach the portal. You get 3 lives and every level is harder than the last.
